{{Quote|I fled into the tangled stars beyond Kitel Phard, following secret ways Xendor had discovered. But the Green Blade followed, and I was cornered on Irkalla.|Arden Lyn|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
During the [[First Great Schism]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Legions of Lettow]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Awdrysta Pina]] and the leader of the [[Legions of Lettow]], [[Arden Lyn]], fought in a '''duel'''<ref name="JvS" /> on [[Irkalla]].<ref name="EGTW" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==The duel==
{{Quote|I exploded Pina's blade, driving its shards through his body. He was ruined, and I laughed out loud to see it.|Arden Lyn|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
Arden Lyn was eventually cornered by Pina on Irkalla<ref name="EGTW" /> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> the two engaged in a duel until Lyn was disarmed. Unwilling to concede defeat, she channeled her strongest emotions&ndash;rage and sorrow, love for [[Xendor]], and despair over what she believed had been unfairly taken from them&ndash;through the [[Kashi Mer Dynasty|Kashi Mer]] [[Kashi Mer talisman|talisman]], destroying Pina's sword and mortally wounding him in the process. In his dying breaths, drawing upon the Force,<ref name="EGTW" /> Pina employed the rarely-used technique called [[Morichro/Legends|''morichro'']] to cease all of Lyn's body functions, ultimately resulting in the stoppage of her heart.<ref name="JvS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Pina had not killed me, though many times I have wished he had. I do not know who constructed my tomb or set me within it.|Arden Lyn|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
At some point, an unidentified party discovered Lyn's body, and constructed a [[Arden Lyn's tomb|tomb]], in which she remained unconscious, only to reawaken [[4 BBY/Legends|24,496 years]] later during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />
